goals: Collect strategic, diplomatic, military, nuclear-policy, and geopolitical intelligence for the DPRK regime

objects.description: DPRK state-sponsored cyber-espionage activity administratively subordinate to an element of the Reconnaissance General Bureau. Alias scopes differ by vendor; APT43 and several vendor clusters may be broader or narrower than Kimsuky.

objects.content: Kimsuky, Emerald Sleet, Thallium, Velvet Chollima, Black Banshee, and APT43 are treated as a shared activity set by government advisories, but vendor collection scopes may differ. TA427, Sparkling Pisces, SharpTongue, Springtail, APT-Q-2, and PatheticSlug are included as related vendor clusters and should not be assumed to have strict one-to-one equivalence. APT37, Konni, and Lazarus remain separate intrusion sets; relationships represent overlap or possible DPRK internal sharing, not identity.

objects.content: This bundle was derived only from the local repository. 681 PDFs and supported text/tabular formats were searched, producing 109 Kimsuky-related candidates. Malware samples and infected archives were not opened or executed. The APTDown leak was not used for core judgments because authenticity and completeness could not be independently verified. Indicators are historical and must not be used as the sole basis for blocking or attribution.
